statements.status_notes: Fixed by upgrading anyhow to 1.0.104 (the advisory's fixed version is 1.0.103) in every Cargo.lock in the repository. Earlier releases were not_affected: anyhow entered the tree only through prost-derive, a compile-time procedural macro, and no code calls Error::downcast_mut (docs/delivery/0065-security-legibility.md).

statements.impact_statement: The advisory's affected range for jsonwebtoken ends at 10.3.0 (introduced 0, fixed 10.3.0 per OSV); this product ships jsonwebtoken 11.x, outside the affected range, so the vulnerable component version is not present. Repository-wide scanners also read the fuzz harness lockfiles, which are not shipped; crates/mqtt-auth/fuzz/Cargo.lock had gone stale at 9.3.1 and has been refreshed to the workspace version. Recorded in docs/delivery/0069-scorecard-remediation.md.

statements.status_notes: rkyv is no longer in the dependency tree: rust_decimal 1.43.0 dropped the optional rkyv 0.7 edge that kept a phantom entry in Cargo.lock, so no Cargo.lock in the repository lists rkyv. Earlier releases were not_affected: the entry was never compiled and no rkyv archive is ever constructed or read (docs/delivery/0069-scorecard-remediation.md).
